solidityVersion: ^0.8.20 (no solc pin in foundry.toml; checked arithmetic)

declaredIntent: Replacement for BalancerPoolerV2 at NFTMinterV2 index 4; _dispatch/_psmDonate copied verbatim so hook, NFT id and minter see an identical dispatcher.
pool(sUSDSIn,minPhusdOut,minLP): closed-form on-chain swap size from live reserves, swap s, addLiquidity(a-s, phusdOut), LP kept on the pooler (decision 5).
minPhusdOut and minLP must be non-zero.
Deliberately NO price ceiling: pushing phUSD above $1 is intended (mint-and-sell arbitrage grows collateral). Floors exist to stop sandwiches, not to cap price.
Pair may be empty at construction; pool() reverts on empty pair.
No pauser() (Pauser registration skipped by design, phStaging2:100).
Required Human Action: MUST NOT be deployed before this audit passes.

reentrancyGuarded.note: pool: onlyAuthorizedPooler whenNotPaused nonReentrant (nonReentrant last; same ordering as BalancerPoolerV2 Q-05). _psmDonate is self-gated (msg.sender==this), reached only inside base dispatch's nonReentrant frame.

initializerProtected.note: not upgradeable; immutables set in constructor

pauseMechanism.value: Pausable via base; pause()/unpause() are onlyMinter (NFTMinterV2.setDispatcherActive). Owner cannot pause directly. pool() and dispatch() are whenNotPaused; rescueERC20 is not (by design).

inboundCallbacks.value: none (no ERC721/1155 safe mint/transfer, no ERC777)

approvalHygiene.note: pool(): forceApprove(router,s) -> swap -> reset 0; forceApprove(router, a-s) + forceApprove(router, phusdOut) -> addLiquidity -> InsufficientLP check -> reset both to 0. A revert anywhere rolls back allowances. _dispatch: exact forceApprove(sUSDS, poolingUSDS) consumed by deposit. _psmDonate: forceApprove(psm, usdsSpent) reset 0; forceApprove(streamer, gemAmt) consumed by collectNudge (unpaired; ledger Q-18 class).

swapFormulaCorrect.note: s = (sqrt(r(r*1997^2 + a*4*997*1000)) - 1997r)/1994 is the standard exact zap root of the 0.30%-fee CPMM (multiplied through by 1000). r = rS = live sUSDS reserve selected via _sUSDSIsToken0 in _reserves() (line 456) - correct for both token orderings since sUSDS is always the input token. 0 < s < a holds over the reals for r>0,a>0 (sqrt(r^2 1997^2 + 3988000ra) < 1997r + 1994a), and flooring preserves s < a, so sUSDSIn - s cannot underflow. Subtraction sqrt(...) - 1997r cannot underflow (sqrt floor of a value >= (1997r)^2 is >= 1997r).

swapRoundingDirection.value: s floored (Math.sqrt floor + integer division) -> marginal under-swap; getAmountOut floor in router; router quote() floor in addLiquidity. Residual is wei-level dust of sUSDS and/or phUSD left on the pooler (not refunded since router only pulls used amounts). sUSDS dust is re-poolable; phUSD dust only leaves via rescueERC20. Story decision 6 bound: (4+4(rS/rP)+4(rP/rS))(2+a/r0) raw units.
swapRoundingDirection.confidence: verified (independent python simulation: 34k/34k reserves, a=1000 -> dust 2 wei sUSDS, 0 phUSD)

overflowBound.note: r <= 2^112 (~5.2e33). r*(r*3988009 + a*3988000) overflows only if a > ~5.6e36 (5.6e18 whole sUSDS) - unreachable; a <= this contract's sUSDS balance. quotePool products (inWithFee*rP, amtS*ts) bounded by ~2^112*2^112*1e3. Checked arithmetic reverts rather than wraps.

emptyPairHandling.note: _reserves() reverts UniPoolerV2__EmptyPair if either reserve == 0 (pool and quotePool). Constructor does not read reserves (empty pair accepted). A near-empty but non-zero pair (e.g. only MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY left) is accepted; only floors protect.

constructorTokenOrderCheck.note: Reverts PairTokenMismatch unless {token0,token1} == {sUSDS_, phUSD_} in either order; records _sUSDSIsToken0. Does NOT verify pair_ is the canonical router.factory().getPair(sUSDS,phUSD) - see LOCAL-UP-002.

zeroFloorCheck.note: minPhusdOut==0 || minLP==0 -> ZeroMinimum. Nominal only: 1 wei passes.

copiedVerbatimFromBalancerPoolerV2.note: Function-body diff vs src/dispatchers/BalancerPoolerV2.sol@2bfa090: _dispatch 0 differing lines; setBatchMinter, setMaxTout, incrementAuthVersion 0; _psmDonate, setBatchDonationSize, setPSM, setNudgeStreamer, setAuthorizedPooler, rescueERC20 and the onlyAuthorizedPooler modifier differ ONLY in the revert-string prefix ("BalancerPoolerV2:" -> "UniPoolerV2:"). maxTout default 0.01e18 and authVersion=1 identical. Story decision 3 confirmed.

quotePoolMatchesExecution.note: phusdOut uses getAmountOut (997/1000); amtP/amtS replicate router _addLiquidity optimal-amount selection with tokenA=sUSDS; expectedLP = min(amtS*ts/rS2, amtP*ts/rP2) = pair.mint with feeOn=false. With feeOn, _mintFee raises totalSupply before our mint, so actual LP >= quote (safe floor). Assumes no unsynced pair balance (see LOCAL-UP-004).

uncheckedReturnValues.value: ERC4626.deposit return ignored in _dispatch (inherited, ledger Q-02 class); router return values are consumed.

localFindings.description: UniPoolerV2._dispatch (copied verbatim) has no hook-type / non-default-hook guard. ATokenDispatcherV2 seeds `hook` with a no-op DefaultDispatchHook, so if the index-4 cutover forgets `setHook(BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook-or-new-hook)` every mint at index 4 succeeds while accruing ZERO phUSD mint-debt, silently (the M-04 condition). The inverse misconfiguration (setHook done but hook.setDispatcher not repointed from BalancerPoolerV2) fails loud (OnlyDispatcher revert bricks index-4 mints). This is the exact asymmetry already filed as ledger Q-08 (96c60b723f, wont-fix 2026-06-17) for BalancerPoolerV2 and L-09 (563df2e64a, open Low) for Uniboost. DISCLOSURE: Q-08's owner rationale was 'BalancerPoolerV2 is LIVE and will not be retrofitted' - that rationale does not transfer to UniPoolerV2, which is undeployed and explicitly gated on this audit (expired-rationale, not a re-file of Q-08). BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook exposes no hookTypeId(), so a NudgeRatchet-style guard would need either a hook change or a simpler 'hook != constructor-deployed default hook' check.
localFindings.recommendation: Store the constructor-deployed default hook address and require(address(hook) != defaultHook) in _dispatch (concrete-only guard; base untouched), or add hookTypeId() to the pooler hook and guard on it. Note Law-2 tension: story-048 mandates _dispatch verbatim; Law 1 outranks it.

localFindings.description: The constructor checks pair_'s token set but never checks pair_ == IUniswapV2Factory(router.factory()).getPair(sUSDS, phUSD). pool() sizes s and quotePool reads reserves/totalSupply from `_pair`, while the swap and addLiquidity execute on whatever pair the ROUTER's factory resolves. A non-canonical pair with the same token set (fork-DEX pair, wrong-factory pair, or test double) would decouple sizing from execution: s mis-sized, quote wrong, minLP measured on the router's pair, and the LP minted is a different token than `pair()` reports (still rescuable via rescueERC20(token)). Floors bound value loss. Deploy-script concern (phStaging2:100 cutover passes pair_).
localFindings.recommendation: In the constructor, require(IUniswapV2Factory(IUniswapV2Router02(router_).factory()).getPair(sUSDS_, phUSD_) == pair_) - requires extending the minimal router/factory interfaces. Otherwise assert it in the cutover script.

localFindings.description: Sandwich protection is entirely the pooler-supplied minPhusdOut/minLP; the non-zero check is nominal (minPhusdOut=1, minLP=1 pass) and deadline=block.timestamp gives no expiry. There is deliberately no price ceiling (story-048 intent - recorded as intent, not a finding). Local simulation shows minPhusdOut is the tighter of the two floors under an adverse (buy-phUSD) front-run (34k/34k reserves, a=1000: a 5%-of-reserve front-run cuts phusdOut to 90.8% of quote and LP to 95.3%), so a tolerance-reduced quote does bound the sandwich. Same class as ledger L-06 (342075dfba, open, BalancerPoolerV2) and L-15 (e64f73d629, wont-fix, PromotionUniV2_Eth). Exploitability depends on who the authorized poolers are and whether pool() is broadcast publicly - defer to Tier 2.
localFindings.recommendation: Tier 2: decide whether this is a new-contract instance of L-06 (open) or falls under the L-15 owner acceptance. Optionally take a deadline parameter.

localFindings.description: s is derived from getReserves(), but a pair holding an unsynced surplus (tokens transferred in without sync) absorbs that surplus into reserves during the swap, so post-swap reserves differ from those the closed form assumed. addLiquidity then uses a different ratio and leaves a larger-than-dust residual of one token on the pooler (not stranded: sUSDS re-poolable, phUSD via rescueERC20). The surplus is funded by the attacker and accrues to LPs (mostly the protocol); no extraction path identified locally. quotePool shares the same assumption.
localFindings.recommendation: Informational. Optionally sync()/account for balanceOf(pair) - reserve before sizing, or document.

interfaceAbstraction.valueFlow: NFTMinterV2 transferFrom(user -> UniPoolerV2, price USDS) -> dispatch: pooling share wrapped to sUSDS and HELD; donation share USDS -> PSM.buyGem -> USDC -> NudgeStreamer -> batchMinter (failure parks USDS). pool(): held sUSDS -> swap s for phUSD + addLiquidity -> LP held on contract (protocol-owned). Exit: rescueERC20 (owner).

trustAssumptions: Router02 at _router is the canonical Uniswap V2 router whose factory owns _pair (not validated on-chain; LOCAL-UP-002).
Pair is a standard 0.30%-fee UniswapV2Pair; the closed form is fee-specific (997/1000).
Authorized poolers supply tolerance-reduced quotePool outputs as floors; floors are the only sandwich protection (no on-chain price reference, by story design).
phUSD and sUSDS are standard ERC20s without transfer hooks or fees (otherwise phusdOut != received and addLiquidity desizes).

Pair seeding at the cutover is done by the protocol at the carried-over Balancer price before pool() is used; pair creation is permissionless, so a third party could seed first at an arbitrary price (bounded for pool() only by floors).
Owner wires setHook(mint-debt hook) AND the hook's setDispatcher(UniPoolerV2) before registering/replacing index 4 (no on-chain enforcement; LOCAL-UP-001).
Minter (NFTMinterV2) is the only pause authority; owner cannot pause UniPoolerV2 directly.
Owner is trusted with rescueERC20 over LP and inventory (Law 3).
interactionNotesForTier2: PromotionUniV2_Eth Leg A now buys phUSD on the SAME phUSD/sUSDS V2 pair UniPoolerV2 zaps into (shallow ~34k/side per plan sec. 5). Price-impact and ordering interactions between the two are cross-contract.
No price ceiling + shallow pool: a modest pool() lifts phUSD above $1 by design (story intent); arbitrage path via PhusdStableMinter is out of this contract.
Index-4 cutover via NFTMinterV2.replaceDispatcher: BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.dispatcher must be repointed (setDispatcher) or a fresh hook deployed; see LOCAL-UP-001 for the fail-open branch.
quotePool is a spot read - fine for UI floors but must never be used as an on-chain oracle by another contract.
